description: This file defines the main SwiftUI view component 'RootCanvas' for an iOS application, which manages UI presentation, onboarding, gateway status, and user interactions within the app.

classes.name: RootCanvas
classes.description: Main SwiftUI View managing the app's root interface, onboarding flow, gateway connection status, and dynamic UI elements.

classes.name: HomeCanvasPayload
classes.description: Data model for representing the state of the home screen canvas with gateway and agent info.

classes.name: HomeCanvasAgentCard
classes.description: Model representing individual agent card info displayed on the home canvas.

classes.name: CanvasContent
classes.description: Child view rendering the main content of the application, including controls for chat, settings, and voice interactions.

classes.name: CameraFlashOverlay
classes.description: View providing a camera flash effect overlay using nonce changes to trigger animations.

methods.name: startupPresentationRoute
methods.description: Determines which startup presentation route to follow based on gateway and onboarding status.

methods.name: shouldPresentQuickSetup
methods.description: Decides if the quick setup sheet should be presented during startup.

methods.name: updateIdleTimer
methods.description: Enables or disables the device's idle timer based on app state.

methods.name: updateCanvasDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug status display on the app's screen overlay.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Recreates and sends the current home canvas state as JSON to the app model.

methods.name: makeHomeCanvasPayload
methods.description: Builds the payload data structure representing current gateway and agent statuses.

methods.name: resolveActiveAgentID
methods.description: Resolves the active agent ID based on current app model state.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentID
methods.description: Resolves the default agent ID from app model configuration.

methods.name: homeCanvasAgents
methods.description: Returns a list of agent cards for display, marking active/default agents.

methods.name: homeCanvasName
methods.description: Returns a normalized agent name or ID.

methods.name: homeCanvasBadge
methods.description: Generates an emoji badge or initials for an agent.

methods.name: normalized
methods.description: Utility to trim and normalize string values.

methods.name: evaluateOnboardingPresentation
methods.description: Decides whether to show onboarding or settings based on current state and configuration.

methods.name: hasExistingGatewayConfig
methods.description: Checks if there is an existing gateway configuration present.

methods.name: maybeAutoOpenSettings
methods.description: Automatically opens settings if conditions are met on app launch.

methods.name: maybeShowQuickSetup
methods.description: Determines if the quick setup sheet should be presented.
